captions.detailed: A torchiere floor lamp featuring a circular base and a slender vertical post. At the top of the post is a fixed, wide, cream-colored dome shade. Branching off mid-post is a secondary reading arm that revolves horizontally via a revolute joint. The secondary arm terminates in a smaller cone-shaped shade that can tilt up and down on a second revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a torchiere floor lamp with a round base and a slender post. Include a fixed main upward-facing dome shade at the top, and a mid-post secondary reading arm that can swivel horizontally, equipped with a small cone shade that can tilt vertically.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a flat cylinder and the main post from a tall, thin cylinder. Model the top shade as a hollowed conical frustum (or a lofted shell) fixed to the post. For the articulating reading arm, create a collar cylinder on the post, attach a curved sweeping tube or cylinder as the arm, and add a bracket joint at the tip. Connect a smaller conical shade to this bracket, defining two revolute joints: one for the collar swiveling around the post (yaw), and one for the shade tilting on the bracket (pitch).
